title: Meter Operations Standard: Estimate Limits, Averaging Periods and Bill Issue Day for the Utility Services Program
content:
# Meter Operations Standard — Program Settings (Utility Services Program)

These settings govern how metered services of the Utility Services Program are estimated, trued up and issued.

| Program | Maximum consecutive estimated reads before an actual read must be obtained | Prior actual reads averaged to estimate usage | First actual read after estimates trues up the estimated usage | Day of the month the previous month's lines are issued | Billing period |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Essentials Utility Plan | 0 | 0 | No | 12 | calendar month |
| Water-Sewer-Trash Allocation Plan | 0 | 0 | No | 12 | calendar month |
| Submetered Water Plan | 2 | 3 | Yes | 12 | calendar month |
| Submetered Water & Gas Plan | 2 | 3 | Yes | 12 | calendar month |
| Submetered Water, Gas & Electric Plan | 2 | 3 | Yes | 12 | calendar month |
| All-Inclusive Utility Package | 2 | 3 | Yes | 12 | calendar month |

## Settings in words

- A billing period is a calendar month on every program.
- The lines of the previous month are issued on the 12th day of the month on every program.
- On the four programs with submeters, at most 2 consecutive estimated reads are allowed before an actual read must be obtained, 3 prior actual reads are averaged to estimate usage, and the first actual read after estimates trues up the estimated usage.
- The Essentials Utility Plan and the Water-Sewer-Trash Allocation Plan have no resident submeters; their settings are 0, 0 and No.

*Illustration (hypothetical calendar):* service used during March forms the March billing period, and its lines are issued on April 12.
